LESSON: WRITING 7.4.1 SPELLING

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.4: Writing 7.4.1 Spelling
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 7.4.1 Spelling, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why should people spell words correctly? 2. How do we learn to spell?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify words with target letter- sound combinations (‘nk’, ‘nd’, ‘ar’) from a list of jumbled words.

2. copy words with the letter- sound combinations.

3. write words with the target letter combinations from a dictation of the words.

4. combine jumbled up letters to make words such as injury, tanker, speed, brake, stop.

5. draw and colour pictures of/describe a hospital, bicycle, car, a handcart

6. make words related to the theme from jumbled letters.

7. take part in word building activities using pocket charts/ print/braille cards or digital flashcards. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify words with target letter- sound combinations (‘nk’, ‘nd’, ‘ar’) from a list of jumbled words.
2. copy words with the letter- sound combinations.
3. write words with the target letter combinations from a dictation of the words.
4. combine jumbled up letters to make words such as injury, tanker, speed, brake, stop.
5. draw and colour pictures of/describe a hospital, bicycle, car, a handcart
6. make words related to the theme from jumbled letters.
7. take part in word building activities using pocket charts/ print/braille cards or digital flashcards. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 7.4.1 Spelling together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration; the learner’s writing skills are developed as they write 3-6 letter words correctly and clearly.

Values:
Responsibility is enhanced as the learner engages actively in word building activities with peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (Self-esteem); the learner’s self-esteem is nurtured as they spell words correctly.

Link to other Learning Areas

All learning areas require learners to spell words correctly.
